verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents an official command-line tool, honeymarker, but its scope is limited to CRUD management of markers. There is no evidence of a general-purpose CLI for querying, triggers, SLOs, boards, or agent-oriented workflows; the MCP server, API, and agent skills are separate surfaces. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI covering core resources (queries, datasets, triggers, SLOs, boards), AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Add, update, and delete Honeycomb markers from the command line using curl or Honeymarker, Honeycomb's lightweight marker management CLI.
a lightweight marker management tool that provides a CRUD command line interface
